# T-1: Remove implicit preparing cleanup

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make init and prepare enumerate or resolve preparing records within the existing 100-runId scan bound without global age-based deletion, and remove obsolete TTL cleanup surfaces.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Init creates a new record while all prior record bytes remain equal.
- Prepare no longer invokes global preparing cleanup.
- Unused TTL constants and prune wrappers are absent from production code.

## Implementation Notes
Use the existing non-mutating PreparingFlowStore listing operation for init warnings. Remove obsolete PreparingFlowStore and FlowManager global stale-prune operations and the preparing TTL constant if no production caller remains.

## Test Strategy
Update set-init, preparing-store, and flow-state unit tests to assert preservation for fresh and 60-plus-minute records and warning membership capped at 100 runIds.
